d: Grace becomes a princess when a summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime.
To his family and friends, Cody Banks is a typical teen. But Cody has a secret - he's actually part of an undercover teen CIA program and has 5 years of special training under his belt.
Two strangers who drunkenly get married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot.

Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."
